name: smwpatches-remove-overworld-border-mario
title: Remove Overworld Border Mario
description:
This patch removes Mario from the Overworld border. Differently from the usual hex edit, it also does this:
- Disable the border Mario background sprites, freeing up the first 16 OAM slots in $0200 (you'll need to fill the hole in the layer 3)
- Disable the Mario palette upload, freeing up colors 6-F in palette 8
- Disable the Mario graphics upload, freeing up tiles $00-$05 and $10-$15 (i.e. the first three 16x16 tiles) in SP1
